comments:
0846dcdf: ; Diabetes Mellitus routine
;
; This routine is used to edit the Patient file (#393).
; It contains the code to handle the editing of the file
; and related fields.
ea95d62b: ;Call the DE input template and go to BEGIN label
7ad3ca17: ; Set up variables for FileMan call: DIE=global root, DIC=global root, DP=file #, DL=LAYGO, DIEL=no audit trail, DU=no update. Quit if no 0 node exists.
60fcc61d: ; If DT field exists in 0 node, store value in DE(1) variable
45c85c27: ; Kill %Z variable and quit
96b18b44: Write instructions for user input at the field prompt.
a2f3a677: Exit the input loop.
25e8fb60: If the input has wrapped around to a new line, move the cursor to the next line and indent appropriately.
a1a6d765: If the input is longer than 19 characters, and the field is not a WORD-PROCESSING type, and the field is a FILE or KEY type, branch to the routine that handles word-wrapping.

f6f24ad4: If there is input and the field is not WORD-PROCESSING, and the field is INQUIRE type and the corresponding computed expression is defined, set the internal value to null and display a message indicating that editing is not allowed.
98846359: Read user input, with a timeout specified by DTIME. If timeout occurs, set DTOUT=U and X=U, and sound a beep.
936eb742: Exit the input routine.
f8623d0b: Initialize DQ (Data Queue) and increment it.
3b998cc3: Branch to label referenced by DQ.
f4ea8f5e: Go to label PR if there is a DE(DQ) defined, otherwise execute W and TR.
c99beb48: If X is empty, go to label A if DV doesn't contain 'R', go to X if DV is empty, go to X if D is less than or equal to 0, otherwise go to A.
26323fcc: If X starts with '?', go to QS (Quit Sequence). If X contains '^', execute D and go to ^DIE17.
4782c9fd: If X is '@', execute D and go to Z^DIE2.
9dffcf3c: If X is ' ', DV contains 'd', DV doesn't contain 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) is defined, set X to the value at that node. If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  '_X.

168bda44: If DV is defined, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. If ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) is defined, execute it. Set % to the substring of DU between ';' and the first occurrence of ':'_X_':'. Set Y to X. If % is not empty and DIC("S") is defined, execute DIC("S"). If DIC("S") returns true and DB(DQ) is not defined, write '  '_%. Go to V.

955d8c74: Loop through substrings of DU separated by ';'. For each substring Y, set DG to the position of the first occurrence of ':'_X in Y. If Y is empty, go to X. Set YS to Y. Set Y to the part before the first ':' in Y. If DG is non-zero and DIC("S") is defined, execute DIC("S"). If DIC("S") returns true, quit the loop if DG is non-zero.
355f555a: If DB(DQ) is not defined, write the substring of YS starting from position DG to the end. Set X to the part of YS before the first ':'.
594350d3: If the Set command fails (X is negative) then quit.
83b8f819: If there is no computed expression, check that the value is not longer than 24 characters. If so, kill the value and quit.
3c11bf38: If the value is a decimal number, remove any leading or trailing zeroes from the decimal portion of the number.
0a4ce97f: Execute any executable code associated with the data item, then kill the variable YS.
c000bad9: Clean up variables and store the value of X in the ^DISV global if the data type is date/time.
80293f67: Exit if the DQ array is defined.
4ab29f98: Set X to the error message.
e54c79dc: Call the DQ^DIEQ routine to process the field and go to label B.
dc53515f: Set up the DQ array with field information from the data dictionary for the current field.

b0b3e6be: If the DE array is not defined for the current field, call the O routine. If X is not '@', go to label RD. If X is '@' and the DV does not contain an 'R', go to label A. If X is '@', set X to the value in Y and go to label N.
9e2d61fc: Set DG to the value of DV, Y to the value in DE(DQ), and X to the value of DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute the code stored there. Go to label RP.
a24e94f1: Resolves pointer values for file data.
46f13a15: Resolves pointer values for sub-file data.
8fa5250c: Handles field-level computed expressions for set logic and DINUM values.
be1166d5: ;Quit if data is invalid, quit if data command is invalid, or go to node ^DIE17 for FIELDUTILITIES edit.
3c4587cd: ;If the prompt is not for word-processing or computed expression, go to Reader mode.
4962ddcd: ;If 'Up Arrow Up' was executed to re-edit, re-display the existing data, otherwise go to Reader mode.
e91b91e0: ;Quit.
37abd7f4: ;Start of Input transform: DGJXE9, first question.
2ceb9bee: ;Set transform variables for DATE DICTATED field.
7f1f87e6: ;Go to Input transform entry point.
77dac7ef: ;Ask for DATE DICTATED using Fileman's %DT; if year < 100 set internal value X.
a5e842fb: ;Quit.
c3351154: Set the X and DW variables and then jump to the OUT^DIE17 label.
ded28fe2: If the user does not enter any data, clear the DT multiple fields from nodes 2 through 8.
6ff95061: Quit the current execution context.
081a1a99: Set the X and DW variables and then jump to the OUT^DIE17 label.
20907637: If the input X is empty, set DGJTST to 'INCOMPLETE' and Y to '@2'.
c1e83531: Exit the routine.

bc9e3874: If the variable DG is defined, execute F^DIE17 and DE routines, set Y to the undefined value U, set DQ to 4, execute X4, then check if Y is undefined or equal to U. If either condition is true, go to label A. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to DQ, and go to OUT^DIE17 routine.

531d111f: Set DGJTDDT to the value of either the APPOINTMENT DATE/TIME field (0^1 node) from the PATIENT MOVEMENT file (#391) if the APPOINTMENT field (0^4 node) in the ADMISSION file (#393) is defined, or the ADMISSION DATE field (0^3 node) from the ADMISSION file (#393) if the APPOINTMENT field is not defined.
4a21296f: Exit the routine.

8196b1ae: If the variable DG is defined and has a value greater than 9, the subroutine F^DIE17 is called. If an error occurs during the execution of F^DIE17, the code execution jumps to the label A. If no error occurs, the variable Y is set to the up-arrow (^) character, and the variable DQ is set to 5. The subroutine X5 is then called, and if the variable Y is not defined or is equal to the up-arrow character, the code execution jumps to label A. If neither of these conditions is met, the variable X is set to the value of Y, the element DIC(0) of the DIC array is set to the string 'F', and the variable DW is set to the value of DQ. Finally, the subroutine OUT^DIE17 is called.
0d2f1681: Exit without updating when the date entered is less than the event date.
cfea1cac: Exit the form.
7bbde3a5: If DG array is defined, call the FileMan re-entry point to update the file, then go to the next screen.
